title: From a Wish to a SMART Plan | Principles of Management Ep 15
description:
Before Chai Corner's second outlet opened, Ravi had no plan, just one wish: sell more. Without a plan, the milk runs out by ten, nobody knows who opens the shop, and nobody knows if sales went up. In this animated lesson we use his chai stall to understand planning and goal setting.

You will see Ravi and his team answer the four planning questions (what, how, when and who), then follow the seven steps of planning as they choose the location for the new outlet: set the objective, make premises (forecasts), list the options (college, bus stand or market), compare them, choose the bus stand, make supporting plans, and follow up every week. We cover the three sizes of plan (strategic, tactical and operational) and turn sell more into a SMART goal, the idea George Doran published in Management Review in 1981. We see planning at work in hospitals, factories, offices and sales teams, and look honestly at its limits, with President Eisenhower's 1957 line: plans are worthless, but planning is everything.

This is Episode 15 of our Principles of Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.
